issues.issue: Whether there is a nexus between the claimant's fear and a Convention ground (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears organized crime and her manager after refusing to sign papers and reporting threats to police.
issues.result_text: No nexus to section 96 grounds established; analysis proceeds under subsection 97(1).

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account and documents are credible and genuine
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says she was threatened, kidnapped, beaten and raped after reporting organized crime, and supports this with documents.
issues.result_text: Testimony not credible; document P-13 found not genuine and newspaper P-16 given no probative value.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a risk to life, torture or cruel treatment if returned (section 97)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says organized crime still searches for her and would harm her if she returned to Ukraine.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to prove a serious possibility of persecution or risk of torture, death or cruel treatment.
